sloka: तमापतन्तं बुद्ध्वा तु युद्धमार्गविशारदः।लाघवान्मोचयामास बलवान् वानरर्षभः ।। ६.६७.४८ ।।
transliteration: tamāpatantaṁ buddhvā tu yuddhamārgaviśāradaḥ।lāghavānmocayāmāsa balavān vānararṣabhaḥ ।। 6.67.48 ।।

translations.english: Mighty Kumbhakarna agitated, making loud noise and frightening all the Vanaras hurled his pike on Angada.
